consents.beast-no-tracking.json: no head tracking, no mode switch, one desktop
consents.luma-ultra-luma-driver.json: our own Luma driver: `tracking` "luma" and its pinned binary under `luma_driver`
consents.luma-ultra-sbs.json: 3D mode: `sbs_mode` scope on a Luma Ultra with its mode switch
consents.luma-ultra-xrlinuxdriver.json: the default start: Luma Ultra, XRLinuxDriver tracking, 1920x1200@120 mode switch
consents.pro2-route.json: the VITURE Pro 2 route: its pinned bundle and settings under `pro2_route`

ended-clean.about: a clean Stop: result done, every output record done

ended-compositor-gone.about: Hyprland exited mid-run; Recover closed every record (Journal.compositor_ended)

ended-invalid-consent.about: a consent that named no valid run: the result is `invalid.result.json` with `run_id` null

ended-pro2.about: a Pro 2 run, ended by its own route (runner.execute_pro2)

ended-refused-tracking.about: refused at tracking, with the fault the runner records for it

ended-refused-verify.about: refused before anything moved: no journal, the reason in `error`

ended-usb-hold.about: a clean run that waited out a USB drop and a renderer stop reason

in-flight-desktop-removed.about: a run in flight after a pill removed its second desktop: that record is done

in-flight-intent-only.about: half-finished: the journal holds its first output as intent only (pending), never read back

in-flight-mid-create.about: half-finished: one output confirmed, the next prepared but not confirmed

in-flight-plugin.about: a run in flight at phase "plugin": consent and progress only, no journal yet

in-flight-running.about: a run in flight with every desktop up: three confirmed outputs

in-flight-tracking.about: a run in flight at phase "tracking": consent and progress only, no journal yet

in-flight-unbound.about: half-finished before the broker was bound: a journal with no `broker` and no records

in-flight-verify.about: a run in flight at phase "verify": consent and progress only, no journal yet

recover-broker-blocked.about: the broker proved the output is not ours; a second, pending output stayed with it too
reasons: XR-2: output name/UUID mismatch
XR-1: output name/UUID mismatch

recover-broker-destroy.about: the ownership plugin refused the removal at step "destroy"
reasons: XR-1: the output did not go away when it was destroyed

recover-broker-evacuate.about: the ownership plugin refused the removal at step "evacuate"
reasons: XR-1: its windows and workspaces could not be moved off it (a pinned window, a special workspace, or a monitor gone)

recover-broker-fallback-unusable.about: refused, and the fallback monitor cannot take the windows
reasons: XR-1: its windows and workspaces could not be moved off it (a pinned window, a special workspace, or a monitor gone); DP-1 cannot take its windows: it is disabled, mirrored or unplugged

recover-broker-refused.about: the ownership plugin refused without naming a step
reasons: XR-1: the ownership plugin refused to remove it (state live)

recover-broker-rule.about: the ownership plugin refused the removal at step "rule"
reasons: XR-1: its monitor rule could not be cleaned up

recover-broker-unavailable.about: the ownership plugin refused the removal at step "unavailable"
reasons: XR-1: the ownership plugin no longer holds a live output for it, or the fallback monitor is not usable

recover-broker-unreachable.about: the ownership plugin refused the removal at step "unreachable"
reasons: XR-1: after the move, a window was still not reachable on a usable monitor

recover-disconnected.about: the compositor socket refused the connection
reasons: XR-1: [Errno 111] Connection refused

recover-journal-missing.about: a Recover refused before the journal: recovery journal missing
reasons: recovery journal missing

recover-mutation-failed.about: legacy supervisor journal: a setting undo the compositor refused
reasons: input:follow_mouse: mutation failed

recover-no-reason.about: a Recover refused before the journal: it said nothing
reasons: recovery did not finish, and nothing said why

recover-not-canonical.about: a Recover refused before the journal: managed recovery requires the canonical runtime journal
reasons: managed recovery requires the canonical runtime journal

recover-not-confirmed.about: legacy supervisor journal: the workspace's first monitor is gone, so it is not moved back
reasons: workspace 3: the compositor did not confirm it

recover-plugin-pin.about: a Recover refused before the journal: recovery plugin pin unavailable: {path} hash mismatch
reasons: recovery plugin pin unavailable: /home/user/.local/share/xr-workspace/plugin/abababababababababababababababababababababababababababababababab/libxr-ownership.so hash mismatch

recover-plugin-unavailable.about: a Recover refused before the journal: consented ownership plugin unavailable for recovery
reasons: consented ownership plugin unavailable for recovery

recover-readback-missing.about: legacy supervisor journal: the setting is absent from readback
reasons: input:follow_mouse: 'input:follow_mouse'

recover-scope-mismatch.about: a Recover refused before the journal: consent does not match saved broker scope
reasons: consent does not match saved broker scope

recover-session-changed.about: the broker cannot prove the compositor is the one the journal names
reasons: XR-1: compositor session changed

recover-session-mismatch.about: legacy supervisor journal: the connected compositor is another session
reasons: input:follow_mouse: session disconnected or changed

recovered.about: a stopped run with outputs left (one pending, one confirmed), then a Recover that finished
